answer: Mirror Delay Ledger.** Each identity must answer random, costly micro-tasks whose only purpose is to mirror its prior response latency profile; verification compares timing against that ledger. A falcon pass rate below threshold freezes payouts. Mismatches reveal cheap automation, forcing attackers into a canyon of repeated real-time waits. Sustained attention becomes the scarce good: each fake identity costs hours of genuine interactive latency before earning anything.
